profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Backend Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the e-learning industry and sales industry. Skilled in PHP, Databases, Ruby on Rails, Ngnix, Golang, AWS services, Kubernetes, Kafka. Strong engineering professional with a BS focused in Computer Science from San Francisco State University.

Have worked on large projects at scale that have to be performant and fault tolerant ranging from monolith to microservice infrastructures.  Believe in building with observable metrics to know what success and failure is and ensure quality bar is always high.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Node.js · PostgreSQL · Software Infrastructure · Virtualization · Integration

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Distributed Systems · Engineering · Debugging · Problem Solving · Strategic Thinking

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Have worked on multiple projects that span the domain space of the core product offerings.  When I first started I worked on our sequences and triggers that allows users to set up roadmaps for their sales pipelines and to take automatic actions when certain data models changed.

For the last few years have worked pretty exclusively on the SYNC team dealing with how we sync data from our system to others following complex configurable rule sets.  We allow users to set up specific field mappings, set up conditions which we evaluate before to determine if we should run a sync, and configure more complex field types like dependent picklists or looking up fields by name rather than ID during the sync process.  

Have worked at decomposing this system into its own microservices while also building out new features for the product.  In decomp it has taken a lot of coordination to ensure not only we can migrate a huge data model out of the monolith, but that we can validate the data and the new system work as expected and there is no data corruption or deviant behavior.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Distributed Systems · Debugging · Problem Solving · Strategic Thinking

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I work on a multitude of projects mostly developed in RoR. We used AWS for our infrastructure.

Our monolith app was built on Ruby on Rails and mainly used jQuery for front end scripting.  So most feature development was in these two features.  I also worked to make our front page and a few select market pages run on a Wordpress app in order to allow these pages to have the content and look be configurable by our marketing team.  It took a lot of complex Nginx rules in order to make each page behave appropriately and render from either Wordpress or the RoR application.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Debugging · Problem Solving

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
I work for DCDC which is attached to the College of Education doing web development on multiple educational projects.  It is a job which constantly challenges me and allows me to continually learn and grow.  

Most projects were Wordpress based and our clients were different colleges within the University of Hawaii System.  Each project offerred a chance to understand different client needs for functionaltiy and reporting.  I was able to work closely with customers to understand use cases, propose solutions, and ultimately implement after getting buy in.

positions.title: Director of Technical Development
positions.description: This was a very small company.  I was the only full time dev there so I had to wear a lot of hats from doing all functional development, working with a small team to come up with new functionality that will better move companies success, find and hire contractors for small jobs, handle all server configuration and maintenance and tech fires, evaluate all possible integration with 3rd party applications and execute integration process, have meetings with potential buyers and existing customers to understand use cases and needs and better make tech decisions.
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Debugging · Problem Solving

company.name: AwesomeStories- A Cure for the Common Core TM

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I mainly developed plugins for Wordpress websites.  I would really develop any functionality that a client needed.  Anything from specific shopping cart needs, with credit card processing and profile storing to developing a plugin that turned the site into a social media fitness challenge and connection web application.

positions.title: Web Development team
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: This was a volunteer project I was working on to develop a full function web application for the church, and a separate one for their pre school, and a GUI that would allow them to easily manage the content of the pages after the project was finished.  It included databases to act as a CMS and manage calendar events for their various ministries.

positions.title: Lead Web Designer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: I contract as a lead web developer for this company.  With it I help with their social media campaigns, attend networking meetings, meet with clients, put in bids on projects, create websites and web solutions, using whatever options best suits the clients needs.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
HealthyPeopleTeam.com
I worked a contract position for this company doing web development work on their current web applications.  The jobs completely  varied and required my knowledge and use of HTML/CSS, Jquery, Javascript, PHP, MySQL.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Hired as Intern and quickly converted to full time status
Our open source project is Pines framework which is a full featured web application project with an advanced object-relational mapper, with complex method hooking functionality,  an advanced package management system, and MVC architecture.  Most development was using PHP, JavaScript, and implementing AJAX.   I also helped in the development of different websites they were running including the design and CSS sheets.  While I've worked on Pines, a big portion of my work lately has been setting up a PBX server running Asterisk, running Vicidial on top of that, setting up and designing the dial plan, integrating a flash soft phone with Pines, and developing special scripts to interact with Asterisk, reload and change configuration files.

honors.title: Best UI / UX Award
honors.description: I competed with a friend in the ATT&T Hackathon where you have 24 hours to build an app.  We made a fun app that followed the elections and displayed information with fun graphics.  We won for best user interface and user experience.
honors.issuer: Issued by ATT&T Hackathon Hawaii · Mar 2016
